campaign.purpose: bounded local activation screen before governed Databricks replay

verdicts.reason: Every screened V3 physical control changes at least one representative circuit by more than 5 ms.
Every representative circuit has a distinct optimum on the reviewed setup grid.
At constant budget, moving points toward chassis is faster on every reviewed circuit while moving them toward any other axis is slower.
This local screen is diagnostic evidence only; held-out circuits, active eras and Databricks replay remain required.
